text: The modern Python packaging configuration file that follows the PEP 517/518 standard and declares the build backend, project metadata, and dependencies (replacing older setup.py-centric builds) is called ___.
explanation: pyproject.toml is the standardized configuration file that declares a package's build system (e.g., hatchling), metadata, required and optional dependencies, and console-script entry points in one place. It is the modern replacement for relying solely on an imperative setup.py, and it is shown in the chapter's my-biosim package example.
